title: Count Valid Triangle Triplets
description: A triple of array elements can be side lengths of a non-degenerate triangle when the sum of its two smaller sides is greater than its largest side. Count index triplets `i < j < k` that satisfy this rule. Input: positive side lengths `nums`. Output: the triplet count.
hints: Sort once or track a compact running state to avoid checking every possible group.
Test duplicates, extreme ordering, and cases with no feasible candidate.
